name: Conventions screen renders the seeded insights and their scan summary
description: Covers the risk class the RTL suite structurally cannot: this screen reads the REAL API across a process boundary, and every unit test for it stubs `fetch`. GET /repos/:id/conventions merges the `conventions` rows with the `convention_scan_state` row into ONE response, so the heading's sample count and the card list arrive from a join the client never performs — that join could return the wrong shape and every client test would still pass. Fixtures come from server/src/db/seed-conventions.ts (three PENDING conventions on acme/payments-api, plus a scan row reporting 84 sample files) — change that seed and this flow changes with it. Strictly read-only: it opens, navigates and asserts, mutating nothing and never triggering a model call. The accept → compose → save chain is deliberately NOT here; it needs a PATCH plus a modal, and `find role button --name Accept` is ambiguous with three identical Accept buttons on screen. That chain is covered where it can be asserted precisely: server/test/conventions.it.test.ts drives it over a real Postgres (including the POST /skills seam that records source='extracted' and evidence_files), and ConventionsView.test.tsx drives it over the DOM. Note the assertions avoid the toolbar's 'Deselect all' and the sidebar's 'SKILLS LAB' group heading: `wait --text` compares RENDERED text, and an uppercase-transformed label only ever matches uppercased.
